title: Tensor and counit descent before taking the adjunction transpose
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], with fixed derived tensors [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], pullbacks $F,F_o$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], and direct images $G,G_o$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image] globally and over an open $U$. Use independently chosen global and small local derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], and exact restriction functors $R_X,R_Y$ [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Given $p:F\dashv G$, a natural tensor comparison $t$, $q:F_o\dashv G_o$, and restriction isomorphisms $\alpha,\beta$ satisfying the universal Hom identity of [lem-pc-open-restriction-adjunction-hom-descent], there exist a local natural tensor comparison $s$ and natural tensor restriction isomorphisms $\rho_X,\rho_Y$. For all $A\in D(Y)$ and $B\in D(X)$, put $v=t_{A,GB}\circ(1\otimes\epsilon^p_B)$, $a=\rho_{Y,(A,GB)}\circ(1\otimes\beta_B)$, $c=\rho_{X,(FA,B)}\circ(\alpha_A\otimes1)$ and $v_o=s_{R_YA,G_oR_XB}\circ(1\otimes\epsilon^q_{R_XB})$. Then $\alpha_{A\otimes GB}^{-1}\circ R_X(v)\circ c=F_o(a)\circ v_o$, with compositions in diagrammatic order. This equation is before taking an adjunction transpose; it asserts neither arrow-isomorphism nor invertibility of a mate.

proof.text: Use the localization interfaces for exact open restriction and the K-flat tensor restriction comparisons to construct natural rhoX and rhoY across the specified independent localizations.

The product of the two copies of target open restriction is a localization. Conjugate the restricted natural isomorphism t by rhoX, rhoY and alpha to identify it with an isomorphism between the precompositions of the two local tensor/pullback bifunctors. Full faithfulness of precomposition with the product localization lifts this isomorphism and its inverse uniquely to s; the factorization identity gives compatibility at every global pair. This uses no choice of right adjoint to open restriction.

Apply the supplied Hom-equivalence identity with source object GB and input p.counit.app B, whose p-transpose is the identity. Injectivity of q.homEquiv identifies alpha.inv.app (GB) followed by the restricted counit with local pullback of beta.hom.app B followed by q.counit.app (rX B). Tensor naturality for beta, combined with the descent identity for t, gives the stated equation. This step does not apply q.homEquiv to the tensor morphisms. Empty opens are included.

theorem exists_openRestriction_tensor_counit_descent
    (p : derivedPullback f ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage f)
    (t : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y) ⋙ derivedPullback f ≅
      (derivedPullback f).prod (derivedPullback f) ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory X)) :
    let rX := (schemeOpenRestriction X (f ⁻¹ᵁ U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let rY := (schemeOpenRestriction Y U).mapDerivedCategory
    ∀ (q : derivedPullback (f ∣_ U) ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ∣_ U))
      (alpha : derivedPullback f ⋙ rX ≅ rY ⋙ derivedPullback (f ∣_ U))
      (beta : schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙ rY ≅ rX ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ∣_ U)),
    (∀ (A : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (B : schemeDerivedCategory X)
      (v : (derivedPullback f).obj A ⟶ B),
      rY.map (p.homEquiv A B v) ≫ beta.hom.app B =
        q.homEquiv (rY.obj A) (rX.obj B) (alpha.inv.app A ≫ rX.map v)) →
    ∃ (s : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme) ⋙ derivedPullback (f ∣_ U) ≅
        (derivedPullback (f ∣_ U)).prod (derivedPullback (f ∣_ U)) ⋙
          tensor (schemeDerivedCategory (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme))
      (rhoY : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory Y) ⋙ rY ≅
        rY.prod rY ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory U.toScheme))
      (rhoX : tensor (schemeDerivedCategory X) ⋙ rX ≅
        rX.prod rX ⋙ tensor (schemeDerivedCategory (f ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme)),
      ∀ (A : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (B : schemeDerivedCategory X),
        alpha.inv.app (A ⊗ (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj B) ≫
          rX.map (t.hom.app (A, (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj B) ≫
            (𝟙 ((derivedPullback f).obj A) ⊗ₘ p.counit.app B)) ≫
          (rhoX.hom.app ((derivedPullback f).obj A, B) ≫
            (alpha.hom.app A ⊗ₘ 𝟙 (rX.obj B))) =
        (derivedPullback (f ∣_ U)).map (rhoY.hom.app (A, (schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj B) ≫
          (𝟙 (rY.obj A) ⊗ₘ beta.hom.app B)) ≫
          (s.hom.app (rY.obj A, (schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ∣_ U)).obj (rX.obj B)) ≫
            (𝟙 ((derivedPullback (f ∣_ U)).obj (rY.obj A)) ⊗ₘ
              q.counit.app (rX.obj B)))
